answers.question: Can I add the Milyan reference rows in Lycian-and-Carian and Milyan-Lycian-B to obtain twice as many independent attestations?
answers.finding: No. Direct traversal finds 9 rows in Lycian-and-Carian record EDIANA-MILYAN-0 and 105 in EDIANA-MILYAN-1. Milyan-Lycian-B has 114 reference rows: TL55=9, TL44c=34, TL44d=71. All 114 corresponding text strings match exactly by source record and source-row index. Summing produces 228 repository representations of 114 nonempty digital source-text rows, not 228 independent attestations. There are two shared digital catalogue entries and three source sections. The Milyan frozen source was copied byte-for-byte from Lycian-and-Carian commit 8ae31f14326b5162271ed699a53343d2c0b657b7, data/raw/ediana/milyan-1-0.json. Source independence and certified physical joins are not established.

answers.question: Do source '?' characters in eDiAna morphology annotations establish independently validated linguistic gold?
answers.finding: No. Exact native record EDIANA-CARIAN-400, row E.Sa 1, 1, has text 'šarkbiom zidks mδane'. Its morphology array is ['nom sg', 'nom/dat sg', '3sg pret ind act ?']; its translation array also contains 'PN / a title ?'. The same morphology string occurs in the frozen raw eDiAna sentence_total HTML, in the third badge-success cell. This establishes source attribution and faithful retention of uncertainty, not independent adjudication. The row's analysis_eligible=true and whole_unmarked_source_string token flags do not certify its linguistic annotations. Native provenance identifies eDiAna corpus=carian, docid=400, URL https://www.ediana.gwi.uni-muenchen.de/corpus.php?corpus=carian&docid=400, raw group /E.Sa 1, raw row 1. The raw row's ref array and native principal_editions array are empty.

answers.question: May I publicly redistribute a native research_delivery package under one uniform project license?
answers.finding: No blanket permission follows from packaging. Milyan-Lycian-B's native guide explicitly says packaging grants no redistribution rights and native component terms continue to govern. A freshly constructed in-memory native package contains 34 listed components plus its manifest; the conservative package audit classifies 27 components unresolved for public redistribution. That is lack of audit clearance, not a finding of unlawful use. Project-original software uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; project-original content generally uses CC BY-NC 4.0; eDiAna reference components and specified comparison adaptations retain CC BY-SA 4.0; underlying editions and images retain separate rights. A separate tools-only export was built and verified entirely in memory: three exact scripts, five terms/notice files and a generated manifest, with no native source/data payload. Its software is offered for noncommercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, retaining the required copyright notice. Tools-export SHA-256: dd154f5414fe9bd883cdfd73bc503cda2bb564b31194ef48abb1568891180059.
